capabilities: Toggle torch mode from the command palette
Darken the editor area with a lit radius around the cursor
Make the torch follow the caret, mouse pointer, or whichever moved last
Configure radius, darkness, glow intensity, glow color, flicker, and speed
Keep sidebars lit while only the editor darkens
extras: Install is manual (copy manifest.json, main.js, styles.css into the plugins folder); the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to dim the interface and spotlight the area around the caret for ambient or focused writing.
summary: Ambient visual effect plugin that darkens the app and lights a warm, flickering torch glow around the text cursor.
